extensions.title: Account for unconfirmable claims so BLOCKED never silently improves the pass rate
extensions.question: Question: what happens to claims that cannot be confirmed at all (missing artifact, external blocker, retired subsystem)? Build the non-response accounting that records each as BLOCKED with a named missing prerequisite, and recompute every published rate BOTH with and without them. Dropping them from the denominator is how a program reports a pass rate it did not earn.
extensions.answer: Unconfirmable claims are recorded as BLOCKED with a named missing prerequisite and a named unblock experiment. Every published rate is emitted twice: with BLOCKED in the denominator (earned) and without them (the unearned pass rate). On the frozen control frame the overall earned rate is 6/12 and the dropped-BLOCKED rate is 6/10. Schema rejects BLOCKED with an empty prerequisite. Live CNF-0137 sampling frame and confirmation-record corpus are absent on this worktree, so no live program pass rate is claimed. SUCCESS:CNF-0143
